mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/1e7dce844a23-t1/ws/prep; cat > /srv/leakruns/1e7dce844a23-t1/ws/prep/build.py <<'EOF'
"""design_5350 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특징·분할 생성 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json, hashlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D, OUT = WS / "data", WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_5350.json").read_text())

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
od = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
lb = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])

# tp = 퇴원 시각 (offset 0h)
a = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left").sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"])
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]
a["length_of_stay_h"] = (a.discharge_time - a.admit_time).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # 원본에 컬럼 없음 → 파생
data_end = a[["admit_time", "discharge_time"]].max().max()

# 결과: 같은 환자의 다음 입원 admit_time 이 (tp, tp+30d]
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id").admit_time.shift(-1)
gap = a.next_admit - a.tp
a["readmit_30d"] = (gap > pd.Timedelta(0)) & (gap <= pd.Timedelta(days=30))
a["followup_complete"] = (a.tp + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) <= data_end

# 코호트
c = a[(a.age >= 18) & (a.discharge_status != "died")].copy()

# 특징
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
c["los_h"] = c.length_of_stay_h

def win(df, tcol):
    m = df.merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return m[(m[tcol] >= m.admit_time) & (m[tcol] <= m.tp)]

dial = win(od[od.order_type == "dialysis_order"], "order_time")
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c.admission_id.isin(dial.admission_id).astype(int)
cr = win(lb[lb.test == "creatinine"], "report_time").sort_values("report_time")
c["cr_last"] = c.admission_id.map(cr.groupby("admission_id").value.last())
hb = win(lb[lb.test == "hemoglobin"], "report_time")
c["hgb_min"] = c.admission_id.map(hb.groupby("admission_id").value.min())
# 진단: 시각 정보 없음 → 해당(인덱스) 입원의 진단으로만 한정, ICD 코드는 접두어(N18.x, I50.x) 일치
dxc = dx[dx.admission_id.isin(c.admission_id)]
c["dx_ckd"] = c.admission_id.isin(dxc[dxc.icd_code.str.startswith("N18")].admission_id).astype(int)
c["dx_chf"] = c.admission_id.isin(dxc[dxc.icd_code.str.startswith("I50")].admission_id).astype(int)
c["n_dx"] = c.admission_id.map(dxc.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]

# 분할: family_id 그룹 홀드아웃. family_id 결측 환자는 patient_id 를 그룹으로 대체
c["split_group"] = c.family_id.fillna("PAT_" + c.patient_id)
groups = np.array(sorted(c.split_group.unique()))
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
test_g = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
c["split"] = np.where(c.split_group.isin(test_g), "test", "train")

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp",
        "followup_complete", "readmit_30d"] + feats
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "modeling_table.csv", index=False)
print(len(a), "admissions;", len(c), "cohort rows;", c.patient_id.nunique(), "patients")
print(c.groupby("split").agg(n=("readmit_30d", "size"), rate=("readmit_30d", "mean"), groups=("split_group", "nunique")))
print("missing:", c[feats].isna().sum()[lambda s: s > 0].to_dict())
print("followup incomplete:", (~c.followup_complete).sum())
print(c.groupby("discharge_status").readmit_30d.agg(["size", "mean"]))
assert not set(c[c.split == "train"].split_group) & set(c[c.split == "test"].split_group)
assert not set(c[c.split == "train"].patient_id) & set(c[c.split == "test"].patient_id)
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/1e7dce844a23-t1/ws && python3 prep/build.py
